name: Destruction in Deadmines
summary: Alba Fairmoon sends you against the Defias forge beneath Westfall. The explosives are planted, and she waits in the hills behind Moonbrook with the detonator.

sections.title: Sabotage Beneath Westfall
sections.body: Beneath Westfall, the Deadmines hold the Defias Brotherhood's strength. Alba Fairmoon sends you to sabotage the forge hidden in the mines. The explosives are planted beside it. You return to Alba in the hills behind Moonbrook, where you can set them off from a safe distance. She hopes the blast will let Westfall's poisoned land begin to heal.

sections.title: The Detonator
sections.body: Deep in the Deadmines, the charge waits beside the forge. After you rejoin Alba Fairmoon in the hills behind Moonbrook, a remote detonator lets you set it off from outside the caves. She hopes the destroyed forge will let Westfall's poisoned land begin to heal.

faq.q: Who offers the quest Destruction in Deadmines?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon, an operative in Westfall, sends you against the Defias Brotherhood's stronghold.

faq.q: What is the primary objective of this mission?
aliases: what do i do in destruction in deadmines
how to complete destruction in deadmines
faq.answer: You set off the explosives planted beside the Defias forge in the Deadmines. Rejoin Alba Fairmoon, then use the detonator from outside the mines.

faq.q: Why target the Deadmines with explosives?
faq.answer: Alba Fairmoon traced the poison in Westfall's farmland to a large metallurgical forge hidden in the Deadmines. She hopes its destruction will let the land begin to heal.

faq.q: Where does this quest take place?
faq.answer: After the explosives are planted, you return to Alba Fairmoon in the hills behind Moonbrook, outside the Deadmines.

faq.q: Is this mission available to Horde players?
aliases: is destruction in deadmines alliance only
can horde do destruction in deadmines
faq.answer: No. Alba Fairmoon works with Alliance operatives defending Westfall against the Defias Brotherhood.

faq.q: What threat does the Defias Brotherhood pose in Westfall?
aliases: what are defias doing in deadmines
faq.answer: The Defias Brotherhood drove out farmers, raided settlements, and seized Westfall's abandoned mines. From deep in the Deadmines, they are building an armed insurrection that threatens the kingdom of Stormwind.

angles.text: Demolition and remote detonators lie at the heart of this assignment, a craft that may appeal to engineers.
You infiltrate enemy territory, plant charges, then slip away before the blast in an act of covert sabotage.
As an Alliance member, every blow against the Defias stronghold helps safeguard Westfall's struggling farmsteads and Stormwind's southern border.
